digest.component_or_area: fsck snapshot rebuild and event store compaction
propositions: fsck snapshot rebuild silently discards order-sensitive events (STATUS, SIGNATURE, COMMENT, EDIT, VERIFY_COMMANDS, FILE_IMPACT) that exist only in prior snapshots but were deleted by pre-Jul-7 compaction

rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log fails to detect incomplete event logs and replays only surviving files, causing the newest surviving event to become canonical even when older closed/status-change events are missing
--repair-snapshots does not honor --dry-run flag, causing mutations when read-only preview is expected
fsck must fail closed and refuse lossy rebuilds when a snapshot cites source_event_uuids with no corresponding files on disk, surfacing affected tickets for human triage
Deleted event files are recoverable from git history at the deleting commit's parent and must be restored as .retired sources before rebuild to complete the event log
A store-wide fsck check must report every ticket whose snapshot cites missing source events, making latent data loss exposure visible before repair runs
